# Hedwig

> Hedwig is the eval gate your payment agent checks before it transacts. The local checker returns a policy decision with reasons before signing; your payment agent controls execution.

## Pages

- [Hedwig | Eval gate for payment agents](https://usehedwig.xyz/): Hedwig is the eval gate your payment agent checks before it transacts. The local checker returns a policy decision with reasons before signing; your payment agent controls execution.
- [About | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/about): Hedwig is the eval gate your payment agent checks before it transacts. The v0.4.2 checker runs locally and returns a policy decision with reasons before signing.
- [How it works | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/how-it-works): The local v0.4.2 checker evaluates payment and swap proposals against policy and returns a decision with reasons. The payment agent controls signing.
- [Proof | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/proof): Inspect a recorded Solana devnet run covering an allowed request, an amount over the limit, missing evidence and a revoked role.
- [Roadmap | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap): Available: local v0.4.2 payment and swap checks through MCP. In development: hosted scoring and original reports. Model training has not run.
- [Team | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/team): Hi, I'm Gabe. I'm focused full time on Hedwig.
- [Docs | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs): Connect Hedwig through local MCP, set your policy and inspect a sample payment check. Your application controls signing.
- [Try Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents): Connect Hedwig to a coding agent that supports local MCP tools. Copy the setup prompt, approve the install and run a sample check.

## Setup

These guides install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): local setup and owner approval.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): payment checks through MCP.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
